notes:
• Company snapshot: mid-market SaaS that provides multi-channel customer support platforms to retail chains. They operate 24/7, ~600 employees, support volume ~8k tickets/day across email + web + chat.

• Primary asks: automated concise ticket/email summaries for agents and managers, automatic topic/intent tagging for routing + SLA macros, integration with Zendesk/Freshdesk workflows and macros. Customer wants suggested macros + single-click apply in agent UI.

• Technical constraints: must install via private Zendesk app with VPC egress to their cloud; data residency requirement (US only); KMS integration for keys; SSO via SAML. Cannot use public-tenanted model variants without DPA and encryption-at-rest proof.

• Performance targets (customer-specified): summary generation <= 1.5s median per ticket for 2-3 sentence extractive/abstractive summary; tag classification precision >= 88% on business-critical labels; p95 latency for synchronous agent assist < 2.5s; throughput target during peak (holiday spike) up to 250 reqs/sec sustained for 30m windows.

• POC scope (agreed): 7-day POC ingesting 5k anonymized tickets (customer will mask PHI), run both Redwood-hosted and Dedicated baseline. Acceptance criteria: 1) summary quality (human-rated >4/5 on 200 random tickets), 2) tag accuracy >88% on holdout, 3) integration demo with Zendesk macro suggestions working end-to-end.

• Security/legal: legal raised SOC2 type II evidence, encryption details, audit log retention. Customer requested a vulnerability scan report and vendor access policy. Legal also wants explicit logging of model fallback events.

• Integration notes: they use custom ticket fields in Zendesk for region/priority/product. Need mapping UI for tag -> ticket field -> macro. Freshdesk pilot possible for one team. Must support webhook retry/backpressure and idempotency for retried deliveries.

• Cost sensitivity: cares about per-ticket cost during POC; target blended cost < $0.005 per ticket processed at scale. Will evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs and recommend quantization for dedicated instances.

• Quote from CTO on 2026-02-25 call: "If we can get reliable summaries + tags during Black Friday without agents losing throughput, we can deprecate several manual workflows."

• Next actions: 1) Aisha to share POC ingestion spec and sample masking script by 2026-03-12. 2) Marco to propose Dedicated vs hosted latency/cost comparison by 2026-03-15. 3) Customer legal to confirm SOC2 document availability (ETA 2026-03-18).

• Jira/Follow-ups: SUP-3412 created to track Zendesk app packaging; SE to add test macros template to drive link.

• CRM voice: shorthand, fragments common; customer pragmatic — will buy if we show clear SLA+cost path for spikes.
